footprint.notes: usStates: warehouse counts by state from the location pages of Costco's 2025 Annual Report, the newest edition (checked 2026-11-24; the 2026 Annual Report is not yet published), which shows '923 locations projected as of December 31, 2025' (633 in the United States and Puerto Rico). The page itself says 'projected', so the counts include openings scheduled through that date. 47 states plus DC; Puerto Rico (4) is left out of usStates because it is not a state, and states with no warehouse (e.g. Rhode Island, West Virginia, Wyoming) have no row. The FY2026 10-K itself gives warehouses only by country, at fiscal year-end (Aug 30, 2026: 939; Item 2 splits them only into U.S. and Puerto Rico 647, Canada 115 and Other International 177), so country rows use the 10-K count and are later than the state map (e.g. U.S. 647 vs 633). Employees are by segment only (U.S. 232,000, Canada 58,000, Other International 65,000; total 355,000); the 10-K does not list which countries 'Other International' covers, so the region has no country list. The 10-K says California 'comprised 26% of U.S. net sales in 2026'; revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated. Sites: only the home office is described in the filing; depots and plants are not itemized.

pay.notes: Employees: year-end count for fiscal 2026, including part-time employees (the 10-K says Costco targets at least 50% full-time and also uses seasonal employees). Payroll: the 10-K says compensation and benefits are its largest expense after merchandise but gives no total, so the CEO pay ratio median is used.
